facts.fact: The Minister of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation launched an interim national Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (interim CSIRT) in Maseru on the Wednesday before the 2 August 2026 article (29 July 2026), to serve as the country's command centre for responding to cyber attacks while Parliament works on new laws.

facts.fact: The Oxford GCSCC/C3SA capacity review, final version dated 31 March 2023, states Lesotho has no official National Cybersecurity Strategy and no national CSIRT.

The Acting Principal Secretary of the ICT ministry stated that Government has designated the Lesotho Communications Authority as the interim Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), ahead of the Cybersecurity Bill; no designation date is given, so the 23 September 2026 publication date is used.
